description: This Java class provides utility methods for reading, writing, and deleting file data within an Android application, encapsulating file operations using the Android Context.

classes.name: SaveData
classes.description: Utility class for file operations such as reading, writing, and deleting data stored in the app's internal storage.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes a string to a specified file in internal storage.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads data from a specified file and stores it in the static 'content' variable.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a specified file from internal storage.
